culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Iwao Ushigome. Conan reveals that the Wolf Face in the camera had difficulty walking since he was not used to wearing the Wolf mask. He has the wrestlers wear Wolf Face's mask and tells them to walk in a straight line. As evidence, Conan reveals that the mask Ushigome was wearing was ripped and blood seeped onto the second mask he was wearing underneath. They find the second mask in Ushigome's jacket with Nagase's blood.

motive.zhHans: 柯南揭示，监控里的「狼面」走起路来很别扭，因为他不习惯戴那副狼头面具。杀人未遂。地点：东都相扑馆休息室。被害人：江户川柯南、目暮十三、高木涉、大神鹰治、佐久间裕之、Leonardo Rossi。下手方式：格斗。犯人：Iwao Ushigome。Iwao 之所以暴走，是因为他的凶手身份被识破，于是想在警方把他带走前把众人杀死。
motive.en: Conan reveals that the Wolf Face in the camera had difficulty walking since he was not used to wearing the Wolf mask. Attempted Murder Location: Tohto Sumo Stadium waiting room Victim: Conan Edogawa, Juzo Megure, Wataru Takagi, Takaharu Ogami, Hiroyuki Sakuma, and Leonardo Rossi Attack type: Fighting Culprit: Iwao Ushigome Iwao was going on a rampage because he was caught as being the murderer, so he was going on a rampage to attempt to kill them before the police took him to jail.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Iwao Ushigome。柯南揭示，监控里的「狼面」走起路来很别扭，因为他不习惯戴那副狼头面具。他让摔跤手们戴上「狼面」的面具，命他们走直线。作为证据，柯南指出 Ushigome 戴的那副面具被撕破了，血渗到了他里面戴的第二副面具上。他们在 Ushigome 的外套里找到了那第二副面具，上面有长濑的血。Ushigome 供认，并揭示长濑想把他们拉下马、转投万国摔跤，而本来该由他去摘大神的面具、他才是想偷走那副面具的人。随后 Ushigome 暴走，打倒了目暮和高木。（杀人未遂）
resolution.en: The culprit is Iwao Ushigome. Conan reveals that the Wolf Face in the camera had difficulty walking since he was not used to wearing the Wolf mask. He has the wrestlers wear Wolf Face's mask and tells them to walk in a straight line. As evidence, Conan reveals that the mask Ushigome was wearing was ripped and blood seeped onto the second mask he was wearing underneath. They find the second mask in Ushigome's jacket with Nagase's blood. Ushigome confesses and reveals that Nagase was trying to take them down and move to Bankoku pro wrestling, he was the one supposed to unmask Ogami and he's the one who want to steal his mask. Then, Ushigome goes on a rampage, incapacitating Megure and Takagi. Attempted Murder
